# telnyx_storage_sql_database (Resource)

A SQL database in Telnyx Storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_storage_sql_database" "example" {
  name = "orders"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Database name. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only; must start and end with a letter or number.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `record_type` (String)
- `status` (String) Provisioning status. A database is usable once `status` is `provision_ok`. Once deletion completes, the database no longer appears in the API.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_storage_sql_database.example <id>
```
